lines.en: With the pick on my shoulder, I head downhill.
The ceiling is low; I walk with my head down.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石一路滚下去。
lines.en: Rubble rolls away down the slope.
I walk along the minecart rails.
Coal dust works into my collar.
I steady myself on the timber supports.
A dead end ahead; I turn.
My pick tip rings against the rock.
The torch is out; I still know the way.
I walk through puddles, not around.
The deeper I go, the closer the air.
My steps are heavy, but they do not stop.
I lean on the rock wall and catch my breath.
Water drips from the stalactite tip.

lines.zh: 口袋里还有半根胡萝卜。
lines.en: Half a carrot is still in my pocket.
I count the forks in the tunnel.

lines.zh: 耳边的嗡声是风，不是人。
lines.en: That hum is wind, not a person.
I lay the pick across my knees.
The iron in this seam is stubborn.
I chew a cold potato.
Now and then a little dirt falls.
I remember it is daytime above.
Your lamp swings into my eyes.
Did you bring a pick?
I dug this tunnel.
Where you step will give way.
I look at your boots: too new.
Do not hold the torch to my face.
Are you here for iron too?

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一车石头。
lines.en: A cart of stone sits between us.
I lift the pick, only to shoulder it.
It is narrow here; you cannot pass.
Dust gets in the wound; it stings.
I steady myself against the wall.
My pick slips and falls in the puddle.
My old wound has split open again.
That one landed on my lower back.
I crouch and clutch my ribs.
The lamp goes out; all goes black.
I grit my teeth; grit falls into my mouth.
What a miner fears is the cave-in, not pain.
I shift behind the minecart.

lines.zh: 你手上有胡萝卜的味道。
lines.en: Your hands smell of carrot.

lines.zh: 甜味从你布袋缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Sweetness leaks from your cloth bag.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃过热的东西。
lines.en: I have not eaten anything warm in ages.
A potato — raw is fine.
I set the pick down.
A trade: I give you iron.
Do not wave it; I get dizzy.
Nobody leaves me a meal down here.
I only want half a carrot, truly.

lines.zh: 饿了就想起从前吃饭的日子。
lines.en: Hunger brings back the days I used to eat.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀卡住我的镐柄。
lines.en: Your shoulder catches my pick handle.
The tunnel is narrow; we pass sideways.
I knock over a basket of cobblestone.
The dust sets us both coughing.
You break the plank underfoot.
I brace the support so it will not fall.

lines.zh: 铁镐磕在石上，响了一声。
lines.en: My pick clangs on stone once.
Do not shove; there is a drop behind.
We collide and both stop.
Shift your feet; my cart needs to pass.

lines.zh: 她也在这条矿脉上干活。
lines.en: She works this same seam.
We split one potato.
She digs faster than I do.
Two lamps, one tunnel.

lines.zh: 她守上半夜，我守下半夜。
lines.en: She takes the first watch, I the second.
She does not mind the dust on me.
The basket is full; we lift it together.
She taps three times; I answer twice.
We were both here the year it caved.
Down here there is no one else.
I pick up a stone flecked with iron.
The ingot is heavy; I weigh it.
Cobblestone fills my pockets.
This carrot is caked with dirt.
What drops is my wages.
I hold the ore up to the lamp.

lines.zh: 铁镐磕到的东西，我收好。
lines.en: Whatever my pick strikes, I keep.
Do not take that rubble; it is worthless.
I pick up my own pick.
My pockets grow heavier.
Footsteps — not water dripping.
I stop the pick and listen.
Light comes from the far fork.
Who stepped on my planks?
I set the basket down and grip the handle.
No one should be down here.
Rust and sweat in the same air.
I raise the lamp toward it.
The sound bounces between the walls.

lines.zh: 这条巷道我摸黑也认路。
lines.en: I know this drift even in total dark.
Someone is at my minecart.
I back two steps into the dark.
Pick tip forward, I wait.
I cannot give up this seam.

lines.zh: 有光晃了一下，不是萤石
lines.en: A light flickered, and it was not glowstone
I crouch and raise the pick.
You stand in a puddle; you cannot move fast.
I have your retreat worked out.
Lamp on the ground, hands free.
The ceiling is low; you cannot raise a weapon.
I close in, testing each step.
The haft turns half a circle in my grip.
The echoes help me hear you.
One pick's length — enough.
A minecart behind you; nowhere back.

lines.zh: 我的镐能敲到你的小腿。
lines.en: My pick can reach your shins.
I have dug stone half my life.
You should not have come down.
Now only the swing is left.

lines.zh: 我在暗处，你只看见镐尖
lines.en: I am in the dark; you only see my pick tip

lines.zh: 这条岔道只够一个人过
lines.en: This side tunnel fits only one at a time

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得出来
lines.en: Your steps lost their rhythm; I can tell

lines.zh: 我把灯吹灭了，你更被动
lines.en: I blew out the lamp, so you are worse off
The pick head bites your leg guard.
I swing it round and down.
Stone is harder than flesh; I am used to it.
The pick strikes rock instead; it skidded.
You dodge, and my pick tip chips.
I strike back at your wrist.
Dust billows up; I cannot see.
The haft jams into your chest.
I am not strong, only heavy.
That blow sinks half a foot into soil.
I pull the pick free half a beat late.
You retreat; I take one step after.
Seven points is no light tap.
Down here, fights cost both sides.
This pick comes in from the side
The pick's back hits your shoulder, a dull thud

lines.zh: 我从塌方的碎石里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the cave-in rubble.
There is a fissure at the tunnel's end.
Cobblestone still falls from above.
My pick is wedged in a crack.
Half a can of lamp oil left.
The smell of iron is thick here.

lines.zh: 我拍拍身上的灰，站起来。
lines.en: I brush off the dust and stand.

lines.zh: 矿车翻在旁边，轮子还转。
lines.en: A cart lies overturned, wheel still spinning.
I remember the exit is east.
Whether to light a torch is a question.
No one has worked this seam yet.
First I test the hardness of the wall.

lines.zh: 生在矿里的人，死也在这里。
lines.en: Born in the mine, dying in it too.
It is daytime above; I do not care.
The torch singes my sleeve.

lines.zh: 井道太深，落地时骨头响了。
lines.en: The shaft is deep; my bones crack on landing.

lines.zh: 水漫过矿道，我呛了一口。
lines.en: Water floods the tunnel; I swallow a mouthful.
The support is blown through and rubble falls.
An arrow is in my back; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 光在岩壁上跳，刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Light leaps on the walls and blinds me.

lines.zh: 口袋空了，连马铃薯也没有。
lines.en: My pockets are empty, not even a potato.
Lightning pours down the tunnel; my pick glows hot.
I fall out of the tunnel and keep going down.
